item.title: Rep. María Elvira Salazar: The immigration mistake Trump has to fix
item.description: Can Republicans win Hispanic voters back by changing course on immigration? In this episode of “Make It Make Sense,” Kate Andrews talks with Rep. María Elvira Salazar (R-Florida) about narrowly surviving the Democratic midterm wave after publicly warning President Donald Trump that his immigration crackdown had gone too far. They discuss ICE enforcement, Salazar’s bipartisan Dignity Act, the economic case for immigration reform and whether Trump could strike a deal before leaving office. They also discuss Venezuela, socialism in Florida politics and what the GOP needs to do ahead of 2028. Recorded on November 18, 2026.
